findings.title: A run on the target would get no harness credential
findings.message: No active grant gives csv-report's sandbox on executor BXWRDyhCGccKPnAH (remote) a Claude credential (CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN, ANTHROPIC_API_KEY, ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN with ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL, CLAUDE_CODE_USE_BEDROCK, or CLAUDE_CODE_USE_VERTEX): a sandbox has no Claude login but what is granted to its project.
findings.remedy: Open the project's Overview and use Claude credential to grant an env secret holding CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN, ANTHROPIC_API_KEY, or ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN with ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL, or paste a token from `claude setup-token` there. From a shell on the hub: cloop secret grant <secret> --to project:/home/demo/projects/csv-report --env-keys CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN. An executor that supplies its own credential can be listed in the hub's executors.harness_credential_exempt.

findings.title: The target cannot get this project's source
findings.message: Every run dispatched to executor BXWRDyhCGccKPnAH would be refused before it starts: the hub could not hand it the project's tree.
findings.remedy: grant one with: cloop secret grant <github-pat-secret> --to executor:BXWRDyhCGccKPnAH --repos acme/csv-report

findings.title: The hub's scheduled restart of the project waits for the move
findings.message: the project's run is paused (five-hour session limit reached) and the hub restarts it at 2026-11-16T15:13:35Z. No run of the project starts while the move is in progress, so a restart that falls due during it waits, and then starts on the target.

findings.title: 3 commit(s) on local branches no remote holds
findings.message: The move bundles these commits with the tree and seeds the target with them (as of the hub's last fetch: nothing was fetched for this preflight).
findings.remedy: Push them first if the forge should have them too.

findings.title: 25 file(s), 16.0 MiB, under .cloop that no database holds
findings.message: The move delivers the task output, artifacts, attachment outbox, checkpoints and spec files among these to the target with the tree. The hub's copy of the project keeps them too: the sandbox spec and the requirements spec go on applying to runs, and the dashboard goes on showing the artifacts. The rest stays where it is and is never sent to the target — attachment contents; the database holds their records, not their bytes (.cloop/attachments): the attachment store is the hub's: its database holds the records and the dashboard serves the files from here; the project's configuration (.cloop/config.yaml): the project's configuration can hold API keys, which never leave the hub; runs on the target get their provider and model with the project's state; other files under .cloop: files under .cloop that are not the project's work stay with the hub's copy of the project.

findings.title: 7 record(s) are keyed by the project's path
findings.message: Knowledge and policy records name the project by its path, /home/demo/projects/csv-report. A move keeps that path — it is the project's identity on the hub, and a device names its working copy after it — so every one of them stays valid. A move that changed the path would have to rewrite each of these. The project's requirements name no path: they are kept in its own database, and its spec file is named relative to the project, so they move with it.
